summary.text: Tom Pruss is the Libertarian nominee. He owns a Toledo printing business, has run for the Toledo school board, Lucas County clerk of courts and, in 2024, Ohio's 9th Congressional District, where he received about 4%. He supports voter ID with free state identification, ballot access reform and ranked-choice voting.

paragraphs.text: Pruss was born in Toledo, Ohio, graduated from Calvin M. Woodward High School and attended the University of Toledo, according to Ballotpedia's profile, which draws on candidate-provided information.
He has worked in the printing industry since 1985 and has owned NorthCoast Print Mail Marketing in Toledo since 2017.
Pruss is vice president of the Northwest Ohio Polish Cultural Center and a former president of the Polish American Community of Toledo.
